reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Superintelligence and limits on AI development
themes.definition: Concern that thinking machines or superintelligence may seek to surpass humans, requiring enforced limits defining where innovation becomes a threat to humanity.
themes.inclusion: Passages invoking superintelligence, machine ambitions, or limits on AI development due to threats to humanity.
themes.boundary_cases: Literary warnings (e.g., Lem) about machines surpassing humans count here.

examples.quote: we need a serious conversation about the limits of artificial intelligence development
if they begin to imitate humans in their thinking, a natural consequence may be the drive to surpass them

themes.label: Humans as subjects, not algorithmic objects
themes.definition: Technology must serve humanity, and humans must remain subjects rather than objects of algorithmic influence; humanity must stay more important than its tools.
themes.inclusion: Passages about AI serving humanity rather than exploiting people, or humans remaining primary over AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Human dignity in the digital realm may also take AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: humans will remain subjects or become merely objects of algorithmic influence
whether humanity will remain more important than the tools it has created

themes.label: AI for manipulation and destabilization
themes.definition: AI must not be used for destabilization, manipulation or undermining the international order; technology should serve truth.
themes.inclusion: Passages opposing AI use for manipulation, chaos or destabilization.
themes.boundary_cases: State destabilization framed as sovereignty violation may also take AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence must not be used as a tool for destabilization, manipulation, or undermining the international order.
Technology must serve humanity and the truth, not chaos and manipulation.

themes.label: Enforced rules as AI outpaces law
themes.definition: AI outpaces existing rules; enforceable rules and an effective, accountable UN are needed.
themes.inclusion: Passages calling for enforced AI rules or UN reform to handle AI.
themes.exclusion: Passages only about limits for safety reasons (use AI_SAFETY_EXISTENTIAL).
themes.boundary_cases: UN reform demands citing AI also take AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: We need rules that will actually be enforced
the development of artificial intelligence, which is outpacing existing rules and testing the limits of our responsibility

value.rationale: Both Polish passages frame AI as a civilizational turning point: fears of superintelligence and machines surpassing humans, human primacy over algorithms, AI misuse for manipulation, and enforceable rules through a reformed UN.
